title: Such an amazing tour. ...
text:
Such an amazing tour.  Fransico, was such a good tour guide.  He showed us the best spots for pics, where to have local
Food and was so knowledgeable.  The day went so quickly.  Couldn’t recommend it enough.
author: Donna_D

title: Had a great time with...
text: Had a great time with Dustin on our private tour. Great conversations, good recommendations for lunch and informative discussions on Ronda and White Villages. Felt more like traveling with a friend vs. a guide. Highly recommend them.
author: Sid_H

title: Great way to visit Ronda
text: Learned about the long history of Ronda while touring the beautiful surrounding. Luis, our private guide made the day more productive & took the stress away. Highly recommended!
author: Gordon_S

title: One of the most beautiful places
text: It was really worthy to go to Ronda.  I’m so happy we decided to take the tour. Our operator Alfonzo was really outstanding.. he went far and beyond to take good care of us.  We were all ederlys, but young at heart, and he treated us with Love and respect.. my God it was amazing
author: PriscillaM_T

title: Amazing private trip, would recommend!
text: My friends and I (6 total) had a wonderful time on this trip. Luis was so nice and extremely knowledgeable about a wide variety of subjects. By the end of the trip we felt like we were being led by a good friend and not a hired guide. The drive was smooth and we saw a lot of history in Ronda and Setenil. I will say that the Viator description is a little different/outdated that our actual trip itinerary - the itinerary given has too many stops to be done in a 9 hour day trip so we didn't make all of them.
author: Cailin_L

title: Nice day trip
text: Very impressive city of Ronda, very clean, nice restaurants, the village of Setenil has beautiful houses.
author: Markus_B
